_comment: Mock for GET /api/seller/products/3/risk (Summer Floral Dress - the HIGH risk demo product with the planted runs-small review cluster).
name: Summer Floral Dress
suggestions: Add a "runs small - consider sizing up" note to the listing; 30% of reviewers report a small fit, concentrated in the bust.
State clearly that the fabric has no stretch (fully lined polyester) - reviewers expecting give are the main complaint source.
Review the bust grading between M and L; most size complaints come from buyers between those two sizes.

quotes.text: Gorgeous dress but SO tight in the bust, I should have sized up
The zipper strains when I sit down. Fabric has zero stretch
Runs a full size small in my opinion
True to the chart for me, but I'm between sizes and went up
